name: What R-value should I aim for when insulating exterior walls in Southern California?

mainEntity.name: What R-value should I aim for when insulating exterior walls in Southern California?

acceptedAnswer.text: In Southern California, the recommended R-value for exterior walls typically falls within the range of R-13 to R-15 for 2x4 framed walls, and R-19 to R-21 for 2x6 framed walls. These recommendations align with energy efficiency standards for climate zones in the region. The specific R-value needed can vary based on your home's exact location, local building codes, and your personal energy saving goals. Consulting with a local insulation professional can help determine the optimal R-value for your specific project.
acceptedAnswer.description: For Southern California, aim for R-13 to R-15 for 2x4 walls and R-19 to R-21 for 2x6 walls, aligning with local climate zone recommendations.
